description:
What to change on the site, and what changes did.
view:
- suggested(includeSkipped?): This week's changes to published pages (title, a section answering a search, links, facts, an AI citation to win back): why, what it could win, status, date, and prompt, the change as a brief to follow.
- other_pages: SEO title and description changes for pages Sightkick didn't write (Shopify, WordPress), before and after.
- issues: What's wrong with the site, worst first: why it matters, how to fix it, the pages, who does it, a prompt to follow, and what was fixed lately.
- health: The site scan: AI crawlers turned away, sitemaps, Google's verdict on every listed page, 404s, redirects and dead links.
- todos: The site's to-dos Sightkick can't do by itself (robots.txt, a dead link while Auto improvements is manual, a profile to claim): yours where you can reach it, else the owner's. complete_todo once done.
- results: Every change made and its reading against the page's own 28 days before, net of the site's trend, undone ones included.
- candidates(limit?): Every change this week's data supports on each live page (the weekly review picks from these), blocked when it can't go now.
name: get_improvements
title: Get improvements
